## Canonical CV Selected Projects (`10/10` Live Public GitHub Repositories — `HTTP 200`)

1. [`company-os`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/company-os): 7 executive AI agents plan, assign, and track a company's work from one config file — Kanban, live logs, KPI engine (Python).
2. [`adaptive-ai-tutor`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/adaptive-ai-tutor): Agentic learning platform with 12 GPT-4o agents for curriculum, tutoring, and assessment (Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma).
3. [`llm-knowledge-base`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/llm-knowledge-base): Turns raw sources into an LLM-maintained wiki with full-text search and Q&A (FastAPI, SQLite FTS5).
4. [`langgraph-newsroom`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/langgraph-newsroom): 3-stage news production pipeline with human approval gates, checkpointing, and error recovery (LangGraph).
5. [`aegis-runtime`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/aegis-runtime): Policy and audit layer for AI-agent tool calls — deny-by-default policy language, saga rollback, compaction attribution, and signed tamper-evident audit log.
6. [`prism-gate`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/prism-gate): OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway — adaptive concurrency, per-tenant rate limits, cost-aware model cascade, and drift detection (FastAPI).
7. [`vecta`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/vecta): From-scratch vector search engine — HNSW, IVF-PQ, and hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with C++20 kernels; 0.999 recall@10 (Python).
8. [`syntara`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/syntara): Grammar-constrained decoding — compiles JSON Schema / regex into token masks so LLM output is valid by construction (20/20 schema-valid).
9. [`enterprise-helpdesk-rag-guardrails`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-helpdesk-rag-guardrails): RAG help-desk assistant with similarity thresholds, code-enforced refusal when retrieval confidence is low, and automated acceptance tests (Python, C++20).
10. [`enterprise-erp-odata-mcp-server`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-erp-odata-mcp-server): MCP server enabling AI agents to query ERP systems over OData APIs with schema validation and tool-calling guardrails (Python, C++20).

## Additional Curated Systems, Verification & Field-Guide Repositories

- [`governed-member-services-agent`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/governed-member-services-agent): Multi-tenant regulated member-services workflow with deterministic tool authorization, grounded citations, human escalation, and a 40-case evaluation gate.
- [`verispec-sdd`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/verispec-sdd): Executable SPEC.md state-machine compiler with C++20 reachability/deadlock/livelock verification and Hypothesis/Vitest property synthesis.
- [`skillbench`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/skillbench): Static information-flow taint analyzer and C++20 Aho-Corasick scanner for SKILL.md bundles and MCP tool schemas.
- [`weavegraph`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/weavegraph): Dependency-aware git worktree scheduler with C++20 Tarjan SCC condensation and 3-way AST semantic merge verification.
- [`tracegit`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/tracegit): Content-addressed version control for AI agent execution traces with C++20 edit-distance diffing and regression bisection.
- [`calibra`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/calibra): Statistical LLM evaluation library (paired bootstrap, exact McNemar, Bradley-Terry CI, 2PL IRT, C++20 MinHash-LSH contamination checks).
- [`enterprise-ai-field-guides`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-ai-field-guides): 15 open-access practitioner PDF field guides and architecture monographs ([handbooks.html](https://nagarjunak-pixel.github.io/handbooks.html)).
